# Part 1: Data processing
## Setup
```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(performance)
library(brglm2)

library(detectseparation)

output_dir <- "results"
load_input <- function(name) NULL
save_checkpoint <- function(object, name) invisible(object)
load_checkpoint <- function(name) NULL
save_docx <- function(x, path, ...) flextable::save_as_docx(x, path = path, ...)
print_docx <- function(doc, target) print(doc, target = target)

plot_swelling_boxplot <- function(data, aes_x, aes_y, aes_colour = NULL,
                                 facet_var = NULL, colours = NULL, colour_labels = NULL,
                                 boxplot_width = 0.4, jitter_width = 0.13, jitter_size = 2.2,
                                 title = NULL, subtitle = NULL, xlab = NULL, ylab = "Value (units as per panel label)",
                                 x_labels = NULL, legend_title = NULL, legend_pos = "none", seed = NULL) {
  if (!is.null(seed)) set.seed(seed)
  
  p <- ggplot(data, aes(x = {{ aes_x }}, y = {{ aes_y }})) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, width = boxplot_width, colour = "grey50", fill = NA) +
    geom_jitter(aes(colour = {{ aes_colour }}), width = jitter_width, height = 0,
                size = jitter_size, alpha = 0.85)
  
  if (!is.null(facet_var)) {
    p <- p + facet_wrap(facet_var, scales = "free_y", nrow = 1)
  }
  
  if (!is.null(colours)) {
    p <- p + scale_colour_manual(values = colours, labels = colour_labels)
  }
  
  if (!is.null(x_labels)) {
    p <- p + scale_x_discrete(labels = x_labels)
  }
  
  p <- p +
    labs(x = xlab, y = ylab, title = title, subtitle = subtitle, colour = legend_title) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    theme(legend.position = legend_pos,
          strip.background = element_rect(fill = "#1F4E79"),
          strip.text = element_text(colour = "white", face = "bold"),
          panel.grid.major.x = element_blank())
  
  p
}
```
## Import data
```{r import}
centreA <- load_input("centreA")
centreB <- load_input("centreB")
centreC <- load_input("centreC")
```
## Clean and combine
```{r clean}
clean_sheet <- function(df) df |> select(where(~ !all(is.na(.))))

centreA <- clean_sheet(centreA)
centreB <- clean_sheet(centreB) |> filter(!if_all(everything(), is.na))
centreC <- clean_sheet(centreC)

numeric_cols <- names(centreA)[map_lgl(centreA, is.numeric)]

coerce_numeric <- function(df) {
  df |> mutate(across(any_of(numeric_cols), as.numeric))
}

centreB <- coerce_numeric(centreB)
centreC <- coerce_numeric(centreC)
```
## CentreA CTCAE GU correction
```{r centreA-tox-correction}

centreA_tox_lookup <- load_input("centreA_cumulative_tox") |>
  rename(
    patient_id      = 1,
    baseline_xl     = 2,
    lf_ctcae_gu     = 3,
    `4wk_ctcae_gu`  = 4,
    `12wk_ctcae_gu` = 5
  ) |>
  select(patient_id, lf_ctcae_gu, `4wk_ctcae_gu`, `12wk_ctcae_gu`) |>
  filter(!is.na(patient_id)) |>
  mutate(
    across(c(lf_ctcae_gu, `4wk_ctcae_gu`, `12wk_ctcae_gu`), as.numeric),
    id = as.numeric(row_number())
  ) |>
  select(id, lf_ctcae_gu, `4wk_ctcae_gu`, `12wk_ctcae_gu`)

centreA <- centreA |>
  rows_update(centreA_tox_lookup, by = "id")

cat("CentreA CTCAE GU grades updated from cumulative data.\n")
```
## Combine into D1
```{r combine-d1}
d1 <- bind_rows(centreA, centreB, centreC) |>
  filter(!is.na(Centre)) |>
  mutate(Cohort = "D1", .before = Centre) |>
  mutate(
    cum_max_ctcae_gu = if_else(
      Centre %in% c("centreA", "centreC"),
      pmax(lf_ctcae_gu, `4wk_ctcae_gu`, `12wk_ctcae_gu`, na.rm = TRUE),
      NA_real_
    ),
    gu_ge2_by_wk12 = cum_max_ctcae_gu >= 2
  )

cat("D1 cohort combined:\n")
cat("  Observations:", nrow(d1), "\n")
cat("  Unique patients:", n_distinct(d1$id), "\n")
cat("  Centres:", paste(unique(d1$Centre), collapse = ", "), "\n\n")

# Save checkpoint
save_checkpoint(d1, "d1_combined")
cat("Saved checkpoint: d1_combined\n\n")
```

## Import clinical data from both Momentum cohorts
```{r import-momentum-clinical, include=FALSE}
momentum_ids_clean <- momentum_combined |>
  mutate(Patient_Id_clean = as.numeric(Patient_Id)) |>
  distinct(Patient_Id_clean) |>
  pull(Patient_Id_clean)

cat("=== STARTING UNIFIED CLINICAL DATA IMPORT ===\n")
cat("Momentum cohort has:", length(momentum_ids_clean), "unique patients\n\n")

define_columns_to_keep <- function(df) {
  all_cols <- colnames(df)
  keep_cols <- all_cols[!grepl("EQ5D5L|FU6M|FU12M|record_id_clean|TSG_OTHER|NON_PRIMARY_TUMOR_TYPE|PRE_CTCAE_TOX_OTHER_GRADE345_1", all_cols)]
  keep_cols
}

# Load both clinical datasets
cat("Loading SBRT clinical data...\n")
sbrt_clinical_full <- load_input("clinical_momentum_1")
cat("  Loaded:", nrow(sbrt_clinical_full), "records\n")

cat("Loading validation clinical data...\n")
validation_clinical_full <- load_input("clinical_momentum_2")
cat("  Loaded:", nrow(validation_clinical_full), "records\n\n")

# Process SBRT cohort
cat("=== PROCESSING SBRT COHORT ===\n")
sbrt_clinical <- sbrt_clinical_full |>
  mutate(record_id_clean = as.numeric(sub("^0+", "", record_id))) |>
  filter(record_id_clean %in% momentum_ids_clean)
cat("  Filtered to momentum patients:", nrow(sbrt_clinical), "records\n")

sbrt_cols_to_keep <- define_columns_to_keep(sbrt_clinical)
clinical_sbrt <- sbrt_clinical |>
  mutate(Patient_Id = sprintf("%05d", as.numeric(record_id))) |>
  select(Patient_Id, all_of(sbrt_cols_to_keep)) |>
  distinct(Patient_Id, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  mutate(across(!Patient_Id, as.character))
cat("  Clinical variables extracted:", nrow(clinical_sbrt), "unique patients\n\n")

# Process validation cohort
cat("=== PROCESSING VALIDATION COHORT ===\n")
validation_clinical <- validation_clinical_full |>
  mutate(record_id_clean = as.numeric(sub("^0+", "", record_id))) |>
  filter(record_id_clean %in% momentum_ids_clean)
cat("  Filtered to momentum patients:", nrow(validation_clinical), "records\n")

validation_cols_to_keep <- define_columns_to_keep(validation_clinical)
clinical_validation <- validation_clinical |>
  mutate(Patient_Id = sprintf("%05d", as.numeric(record_id))) |>
  select(Patient_Id, all_of(validation_cols_to_keep)) |>
  distinct(Patient_Id, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  mutate(across(!Patient_Id, as.character))
cat("  Clinical variables extracted:", nrow(clinical_validation), "unique patients\n\n")

# Stack both clinical datasets (rbind)
cat("=== COMBINING CLINICAL DATASETS ===\n")
common_cols <- intersect(colnames(clinical_sbrt), colnames(clinical_validation))
cat("  Common columns between cohorts:", length(common_cols), "\n")

# Stack with only common columns
clinical_combined <- bind_rows(
  clinical_sbrt |> select(all_of(common_cols)),
  clinical_validation |> select(all_of(common_cols))
)

clinical_combined <- clinical_combined |>
  distinct(Patient_Id, .keep_all = TRUE)

cat("  Combined dataset: ", nrow(clinical_combined), "unique patients, ", ncol(clinical_combined), "columns\n\n")

cat("=== JOINING TO VOLUME DATA ===\n")

momentum_combined <- momentum_combined |>
  mutate(Patient_Id_numeric = as.numeric(Patient_Id))

clinical_combined <- clinical_combined |>
  mutate(Patient_Id_numeric = as.numeric(Patient_Id))

momentum_combined <- momentum_combined |>
  left_join(
    clinical_combined |> select(-Patient_Id),
    by = "Patient_Id_numeric", 
    relationship = "many-to-one"
  ) |>
  select(-Patient_Id_numeric)

cat("  Join complete\n")
cat("  Patient_Id format normalised for join\n")

# Summary
cat("=== CLINICAL DATA IMPORT COMPLETE ===\n")
cat("Total patients in momentum_combined:", n_distinct(momentum_combined$Patient_Id), "\n")
cat("momentum_combined dimensions:", nrow(momentum_combined), "rows x", ncol(momentum_combined), "columns\n\n")
```
## Consolidate clinical data columns
```{r consolidate-clinical, include=FALSE}

cat("=== CONSOLIDATING CLINICAL VARIABLES ===\n")

if ("TREAT_OTHER_HORMONE_YN" %in% colnames(momentum_combined)) {
  momentum_combined <- momentum_combined |>
    mutate(ADT_Use = case_when(
      TREAT_OTHER_HORMONE_YN %in% c("1", 1) ~ "Yes",
      TREAT_OTHER_HORMONE_YN %in% c("0", 0) ~ "No",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ))
  cat("  ADT_Use derived from TREAT_OTHER_HORMONE_YN\n")
} else {
  cat("  TREAT_OTHER_HORMONE_YN not found -- ADT_Use not created\n")
}

classify_t_stage <- function(x) {
  x <- toupper(trimws(x))
  case_when(
    is.na(x) | x %in% c("", "-1", "NA") ~ NA_character_,
    grepl("^T1", x) ~ "T1",
    grepl("^T2", x) ~ "T2",
    grepl("^T3", x) ~ "T3",
    grepl("^T4", x) ~ "T4",
    TRUE ~ "Other"
  )
}

if (all(c("BASE_C61_CLIN_T", "PRE_C61_CLIN_T") %in% colnames(momentum_combined))) {
  momentum_combined <- momentum_combined |>
    mutate(T_STAGE_GROUP = coalesce(
      classify_t_stage(BASE_C61_CLIN_T),
      classify_t_stage(PRE_C61_CLIN_T)
    ))
  cat("  T_STAGE_GROUP derived from BASE_C61_CLIN_T (fallback: PRE_C61_CLIN_T)\n")
} else if ("BASE_C61_CLIN_T" %in% colnames(momentum_combined)) {
  momentum_combined <- momentum_combined |>
    mutate(T_STAGE_GROUP = classify_t_stage(BASE_C61_CLIN_T))
  cat("  T_STAGE_GROUP derived from BASE_C61_CLIN_T\n")
} else {
  cat("  BASE_C61_CLIN_T not found -- T_STAGE_GROUP not created\n")
}

if (all(c("IC_DATE", "YEAR_OF_BIRTH") %in% colnames(momentum_combined))) {
  momentum_combined <- momentum_combined |>
    mutate(AGE_DIAGNOSIS = as.integer(format(as.Date(IC_DATE, "%m/%d/%Y"), "%Y")) - as.numeric(YEAR_OF_BIRTH))
  cat("  AGE_DIAGNOSIS derived from IC_DATE - YEAR_OF_BIRTH\n")
} else {
  cat("  IC_DATE and/or YEAR_OF_BIRTH not found -- AGE_DIAGNOSIS not created\n")
}

cat("\nADT_Use distribution (unique patients):\n")
momentum_combined |> distinct(Patient_Id, .keep_all = TRUE) |> count(ADT_Use) |> print()
cat("\nT_STAGE_GROUP distribution (unique patients):\n")
momentum_combined |> distinct(Patient_Id, .keep_all = TRUE) |> count(T_STAGE_GROUP) |> print()
cat("\nAGE_DIAGNOSIS summary (unique patients):\n")
momentum_combined |> distinct(Patient_Id, .keep_all = TRUE) |> pull(AGE_DIAGNOSIS) |> summary() |> print()
cat("\n")

# Save checkpoint
save_checkpoint(momentum_combined, "momentum_combined_consolidated")
cat("✓ Saved checkpoint: momentum_combined_consolidated\n\n")
```
## Update ADT_Use from June 2026 data extract
```{r update-adt, include=FALSE}
adt_update <- load_input("clinical_momentum_adt_update") |>
  filter(!is.na(record_id)) |>
  mutate(
    Patient_Id_numeric = record_id,
    ADT_Use_new = case_when(
      TREAT_OTHER_HORMONE_YN == 1  ~ "Yes",
      TREAT_OTHER_HORMONE_YN == 0  ~ "No",
      TRUE                         ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(ADT_Use_new)) |>
  select(Patient_Id_numeric, ADT_Use_new)

cat("ADT update file loaded:\n")
cat("  Rows with usable ADT value:", nrow(adt_update), "\n")
cat("  Yes:", sum(adt_update$ADT_Use_new == "Yes"), 
    "| No:", sum(adt_update$ADT_Use_new == "No"), "\n\n")

n_before <- sum(!is.na(momentum_combined$ADT_Use))

momentum_combined <- momentum_combined |>
  mutate(Patient_Id_numeric = as.numeric(Patient_Id)) |>
  left_join(adt_update, by = "Patient_Id_numeric") |>
  mutate(
    ADT_Use = if_else(!is.na(ADT_Use_new), ADT_Use_new, ADT_Use)
  ) |>
  select(-Patient_Id_numeric, -ADT_Use_new)

n_after <- sum(!is.na(momentum_combined$ADT_Use))

cat("ADT_Use updated:\n")
cat("  Non-NA before:", n_before, "\n")
cat("  Non-NA after: ", n_after, "(+", n_after - n_before, "patients)\n\n")

momentum_combined <- momentum_combined |>
  mutate(ADT_Use = case_when(
    ADT_Use == "Y" ~ "Yes",
    ADT_Use == "N" ~ "No",
    TRUE           ~ ADT_Use
  ))

cat("ADT_Use distribution (MOM, after normalisation):\n")
momentum_combined |>
  filter(Cohort == "MOM") |>
  distinct(Patient_Id, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  count(ADT_Use, name = "n") |>
  print()
```
## Clean up date columns (keep key dates only)
```{r cleanup-dates, include=FALSE}

cat("=== CLEANING UP DATE COLUMNS ===\n\n")

dates_to_keep <- c(
  "IC_DATE",
  "BASE_PRIMARY_TUMOR_DATE",
  "TREAT_RT_PHASE_1_START_DATE",
  "TREAT_RT_PHASE_1_END_DATE",
  "EOS_END_DATE",
  "EOS_DEATH_DATE"
)

dates_to_keep <- dates_to_keep[dates_to_keep %in% colnames(momentum_combined)]

# Remove all other date columns
dates_to_remove <- grep("DATE|date", colnames(momentum_combined), value = TRUE)
dates_to_remove <- setdiff(dates_to_remove, dates_to_keep)

momentum_combined <- momentum_combined |>
  select(-all_of(dates_to_remove))

cat("Kept dates:", length(dates_to_keep), "\n")
cat("Removed dates:", length(dates_to_remove), "\n")
cat("momentum_combined now has:", ncol(momentum_combined), "columns\n\n")
```
## Exclude MOMENTUM patients: T3/T4 clinical stage, baseline PSA > 20, or Gleason Grade Group 4/5
```{r exclude-mom-tstage-psa}
mom_psa_numeric <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(momentum_combined$PRE_C61_PSA))

excl_stage <- momentum_combined$Cohort == "MOM" &
  momentum_combined$T_STAGE_GROUP %in% c("T3", "T4")
excl_psa <- momentum_combined$Cohort == "MOM" &
  !is.na(mom_psa_numeric) & mom_psa_numeric > 20

mom_gleason_primary   <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(momentum_combined$PRE_C61_GLEASON_SCORE_PRIMARY))
mom_gleason_secondary <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(momentum_combined$PRE_C61_GLEASON_SCORE_SECONDARY))
mom_gleason_total     <- mom_gleason_primary + mom_gleason_secondary
mom_grade_group <- case_when(
  is.na(mom_gleason_primary) | is.na(mom_gleason_secondary)     ~ NA_character_,
  mom_gleason_primary <= 3 & mom_gleason_secondary <= 3          ~ "GG1",
  mom_gleason_primary == 3 & mom_gleason_secondary == 4          ~ "GG2",
  mom_gleason_primary == 4 & mom_gleason_secondary == 3          ~ "GG3",
  mom_gleason_total == 8                                          ~ "GG4",
  mom_gleason_total >= 9                                          ~ "GG5",
  TRUE ~ NA_character_
)
excl_gg <- momentum_combined$Cohort == "MOM" &
  !is.na(mom_grade_group) & mom_grade_group %in% c("GG4", "GG5")

mom_ids_before <- momentum_combined |> filter(Cohort == "MOM") |> distinct(Patient_Id) |> nrow()
excl_ids <- unique(momentum_combined$Patient_Id[excl_stage | excl_psa | excl_gg])

n_mom_pre_sap_excl <- mom_ids_before
n_excl_stage_only  <- n_distinct(momentum_combined$Patient_Id[excl_stage])
n_excl_psa_only    <- n_distinct(momentum_combined$Patient_Id[excl_psa])
n_excl_gg_only     <- n_distinct(momentum_combined$Patient_Id[excl_gg])
n_excl_sap_total   <- length(excl_ids)

cat("=== MOMENTUM EXCLUSION: T-STAGE (T3/T4), BASELINE PSA > 20, GG4/GG5 ===\n")
cat("  MOMENTUM patients before exclusion:", mom_ids_before, "\n")
cat("  Excluded for T3/T4 stage: ", n_excl_stage_only, "\n")
cat("  Excluded for PSA > 20:    ", n_excl_psa_only, "\n")
cat("  Excluded for GG4/GG5:     ", n_excl_gg_only, "\n")
cat("  Excluded for stage & PSA (overlap):     ", n_distinct(momentum_combined$Patient_Id[excl_stage & excl_psa]), "\n")
cat("  Excluded for stage & GG (overlap):      ", n_distinct(momentum_combined$Patient_Id[excl_stage & excl_gg]), "\n")
cat("  Excluded for PSA & GG (overlap):        ", n_distinct(momentum_combined$Patient_Id[excl_psa & excl_gg]), "\n")
cat("  Total excluded (unique):  ", n_excl_sap_total, "\n")

momentum_combined <- momentum_combined |>
  filter(!(Patient_Id %in% excl_ids))

n_mom_post_sap_excl <- momentum_combined |> filter(Cohort == "MOM") |> distinct(Patient_Id) |> nrow()
mom_ids_after <- n_mom_post_sap_excl
cat("  MOMENTUM patients after exclusion:", mom_ids_after, "\n\n")

save_checkpoint(momentum_combined, "momentum_combined_stage_psa_filtered")
cat("Saved checkpoint: momentum_combined_stage_psa_filtered\n\n")
```
## Merge D1 volume and clinical data with momentum_combined
```{r merge-d1-with-momentum, include=FALSE}

cat("=== MERGING D1 COHORT WITH MOMENTUM_COMBINED ===\n\n")

max_momentum_id <- momentum_combined |>
  pull(Patient_Id) |>
  as.numeric() |>
  max(na.rm = TRUE)

cat("Max existing momentum Patient_Id:", max_momentum_id, "\n")
cat("D1 patients will be assigned IDs:", max_momentum_id + 1, "to", max_momentum_id + nrow(d1), "\n\n")

d1_transformed <- d1 |>
  mutate(
    Patient_Id = sprintf("%05d", seq(max_momentum_id + 1, max_momentum_id + n())),
    D1_id = id,
    
    STUDY_SITE = Centre,
    PRE_C61_PSA = baseline_psa,
    PRE_CTCAE_GU_max_grade = baseline_ctcae_gu,
    FU3M_CTCAE_GU_max_grade = cum_max_ctcae_gu,
    
    .keep = "all"
  ) |>
  select(
    Patient_Id, D1_id, Cohort, STUDY_SITE,
    age, ethnicity, ps,
    baseline_pvol, gleason, t_stage, adt,
    PRE_C61_PSA, PRE_CTCAE_GU_max_grade,
    baseline_ipss_tot, baseline_ipss_qol, baseline_epic_uo, baseline_epic_ui,
    lf_ctcae_gu, lf_ipss_tot, lf_ipss_qol,
    `4wk_ctcae_gu`, `4wk_ipss_tot`, `4wk_ipss_qol`, `4wk_epic_uo`, `4wk_epic_ui`,
    FU3M_CTCAE_GU_max_grade, `12wk_ipss_tot`, `12wk_ipss_qol`, `12wk_epic_uo`, `12wk_epic_ui`, `12wk_psa`,
    fx1_ctv_vol, fx2_ctv_vol, fx3_ctv_vol, fx4_ctv_vol, fx5_ctv_vol
  )

cat("D1 data transformed:", nrow(d1_transformed), "patients x", ncol(d1_transformed), "columns\n\n")

# Get data types from momentum_combined
get_mom_type <- function(col) {
  if (col %in% colnames(momentum_combined)) {
    class(momentum_combined[[col]])[1]
  } else {
    "character"
  }
}

for (col in colnames(d1_transformed)) {
  mom_type <- get_mom_type(col)
  
  if (mom_type == "numeric") {
    d1_transformed[[col]] <- as.numeric(d1_transformed[[col]])
  } else if (mom_type == "integer") {
    d1_transformed[[col]] <- as.integer(d1_transformed[[col]])
  } else {
    d1_transformed[[col]] <- as.character(d1_transformed[[col]])
  }
}

momentum_cols <- colnames(momentum_combined)
d1_transformed_cols <- colnames(d1_transformed)
cols_missing_in_d1 <- setdiff(momentum_cols, d1_transformed_cols)

na_cols_list <- list()
for (col in cols_missing_in_d1) {
  mom_type <- class(momentum_combined[[col]])[1]
  if (mom_type == "numeric") {
    na_cols_list[[col]] <- NA_real_
  } else if (mom_type == "integer") {
    na_cols_list[[col]] <- NA_integer_
  } else if (mom_type == "Date") {
    na_cols_list[[col]] <- NA_character_ |> as.Date()
  } else if (mom_type == "POSIXct") {
    na_cols_list[[col]] <- as.POSIXct(NA_character_)
  } else {
    na_cols_list[[col]] <- NA_character_
  }
}

d1_padded <- d1_transformed |>
  bind_cols(na_cols_list) |>
  select(all_of(momentum_cols), everything())

cat("D1 padded with", length(cols_missing_in_d1), "momentum-specific columns (as NA)\n\n")

momentum_combined <- bind_rows(momentum_combined, d1_padded)

cat("=== FINAL COMBINED DATASET ===\n")
cat("Total unique patients:", n_distinct(momentum_combined$Patient_Id), "\n")
cat("Total rows:", nrow(momentum_combined), "\n")
cat("Total columns:", ncol(momentum_combined), "\n\n")
cat("\u2713 D1 data merged successfully. momentum_combined is now the combined dataset.\n\n")

# Save checkpoint
save_checkpoint(momentum_combined, "momentum_d1_combined")
cat("\u2713 Saved checkpoint: momentum_d1_combined\n\n")
```
## CONSORT-style Patient Flow Summary
```{r consort-summary}
#| echo: false

cat("\n")
cat("+----------------------------------------------------------------------------+\n")
cat("|                    PATIENT FLOW THROUGH ANALYSIS PIPELINE                  |\n")
cat("+----------------------------------------------------------------------------+\n\n")

cat("+- D1 COHORT (3 Centres: CentreA, CentreC, CentreB) ------------------------------------+\n")
centreA_n <- n_distinct(centreA$id)
centreB_n <- n_distinct(centreB$id)
centreC_n <- n_distinct(centreC$id)
d1_n <- n_distinct(d1$id)
cat(sprintf("  CentreA centre:                        %4d patients\n", centreA_n))
cat(sprintf("  CentreB centre:                        %4d patients\n", centreB_n))
cat(sprintf("  CentreC centre:                        %4d patients\n", centreC_n))
cat(sprintf("  --------------------------------------------\n"))
cat(sprintf("  D1 TOTAL (combined):               %4d patients\n", d1_n))
cat("\n")

cat("+- MOMENTUM COHORT (pipeline-derived: training + validation SBRT) ---------+\n")
mom_patients_n <- n_distinct(momentum_combined$Patient_Id[momentum_combined$Cohort == "MOM"], na.rm = TRUE)
cat(sprintf("  Combined SBRT training + validation patients: %4d\n", mom_patients_n))
cat("  (Training + validation cohorts from the upstream data-preparation pipeline)\n")
cat(sprintf("  MOMENTUM TOTAL:                    %4d unique patients\n", n_distinct(momentum_combined$Patient_Id)))
cat(sprintf("    (volume measurements: %d rows)\n", nrow(momentum_combined)))
cat("\n")
cat("+- FINAL MERGED DATASET -----------------------------------------------------+\n")
final_total <- n_distinct(momentum_combined$Patient_Id)
mom_only <- n_distinct(momentum_combined$Patient_Id[momentum_combined$Cohort == "MOM"], na.rm = TRUE)
d1_in_final <- n_distinct(momentum_combined$Patient_Id[momentum_combined$Cohort == "D1"], na.rm = TRUE)

cat(sprintf("  Momentum cohort (already counted): %4d patients\n", mom_only))
cat(sprintf("  D1 cohort (newly added):           %4d patients\n", d1_in_final))
cat(sprintf("  --------------------------------------------\n"))
cat(sprintf("  GRAND TOTAL:                       %4d unique patients\n", final_total))
cat(sprintf("    (total volume measurements: %d rows)\n", nrow(momentum_combined)))
cat("\n")

cat("+- COMPLETENESS BY COHORT ----------------------------------------------------+\n")
cat("\n  D1 Cohort Data Completeness:\n")
cat(sprintf("    \u2713 T stage:           %3.1f%% complete (%d / %d)\n", 
            sum(!is.na(d1$t_stage)) / nrow(d1) * 100, sum(!is.na(d1$t_stage)), nrow(d1)))
cat(sprintf("    \u2713 Pre-treatment PSA: %3.1f%% complete (%d / %d)\n", 
            sum(!is.na(d1$baseline_psa)) / nrow(d1) * 100, sum(!is.na(d1$baseline_psa)), nrow(d1)))
cat(sprintf("    \u2713 ADT status:        %3.1f%% complete (%d / %d)\n", 
            sum(!is.na(d1$adt)) / nrow(d1) * 100, sum(!is.na(d1$adt)), nrow(d1)))
cat(sprintf("    \u2713 Age:               %3.1f%% complete (%d / %d)\n", 
            sum(!is.na(d1$age)) / nrow(d1) * 100, sum(!is.na(d1$age)), nrow(d1)))

cat("\n  Momentum Cohort Data Completeness (from clinical data):\n")
mom_data <- momentum_combined |> filter(Cohort == "MOM") |> distinct(Patient_Id, .keep_all = TRUE)
cat(sprintf("    \u2713 T stage:           %3.1f%% (%d / %d patients)\n", 
            sum(!is.na(mom_data$T_stage)) / nrow(mom_data) * 100, sum(!is.na(mom_data$T_stage)), nrow(mom_data)))
cat(sprintf("    \u2713 Pre-treatment PSA: %3.1f%% (%d / %d patients)\n", 
            sum(!is.na(mom_data$PRE_C61_PSA)) / nrow(mom_data) * 100, sum(!is.na(mom_data$PRE_C61_PSA)), nrow(mom_data)))
cat(sprintf("    \u2713 ADT status:        %3.1f%% (%d / %d patients)\n", 
            sum(!is.na(mom_data$ADT_Use)) / nrow(mom_data) * 100, sum(!is.na(mom_data$ADT_Use)), nrow(mom_data)))
cat(sprintf("    \u2713 Age:               %3.1f%% (%d / %d patients)\n", 
            sum(!is.na(mom_data$AGE_DIAGNOSIS)) / nrow(mom_data) * 100, sum(!is.na(mom_data$AGE_DIAGNOSIS)), nrow(mom_data)))

cat("\n+----------------------------------------------------------------------------+\n\n")
```

## Per-fraction % change from first available volume
```{r pct-change}
fx_cols <- c("fx1_ctv_vol", "fx2_ctv_vol", "fx3_ctv_vol", "fx4_ctv_vol", "fx5_ctv_vol")

d1 <- d1 |>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(
    fx_ref = first(na.omit(c_across(all_of(fx_cols)))),
    across(
      all_of(fx_cols),
      ~ round((. - fx_ref) / fx_ref * 100, 1),
      .names = "{sub('_ctv_vol', '', .col)}_pct"
    )
  ) |>
  ungroup()
```

```{r save-d1-pct}
save_checkpoint(d1, "d1_pct")
cat("Saved checkpoint: d1_pct\n")
```

```{r}
d1 <- load_checkpoint("d1_pct")
```
## Effective radius and swelling metrics
### Effective radius and Δr per fraction
```{r delta-r}
momentum_combined <- momentum_combined |>
  mutate(
    r_t_cm = if_else(!is.na(Volume), 
                     (3 * Volume / (4 * pi)) ^ (1/3), 
                     NA_real_)
  ) |>
  group_by(Patient_Id) |>
  mutate(
    r_ref_cm = first(na.omit(r_t_cm)),
    delta_r_mm = if_else(!is.na(r_t_cm) & !is.na(r_ref_cm),
                         10 * (r_t_cm - r_ref_cm),
                         NA_real_)
  ) |>
  ungroup()

cat("Effective radius and delta_r calculated:\n")
cat("  Rows with r_t_cm:", sum(!is.na(momentum_combined$r_t_cm)), 
    "(", n_distinct(momentum_combined$Patient_Id[!is.na(momentum_combined$r_t_cm)]), "unique patients)\n")
cat("  Rows with delta_r_mm:", sum(!is.na(momentum_combined$delta_r_mm)), 
    "(", n_distinct(momentum_combined$Patient_Id[!is.na(momentum_combined$delta_r_mm)]), "unique patients)\n")
cat("  (Note: delta_r is relative to each patient's first available fraction, not necessarily Fx1)\n")
```
### D1 long-format volume prep
```{r d1-long-prep}
d1_long <- d1 |>
  mutate(fx5_ctv_vol = if_else(Centre == "centreB" & id == 8, NA_real_, fx5_ctv_vol)) |>
  select(Centre, id, starts_with("fx") & ends_with("_ctv_vol")) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols          = starts_with("fx"),
    names_to      = "Fraction",
    values_to     = "Volume",
    names_pattern = "fx([0-9])_ctv_vol"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    Fraction = as.numeric(Fraction),
    Centre   = as.character(Centre)
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(Volume)) |>
  mutate(patient_uid = paste(Centre, id, sep = "_"))

cat("d1_long created:", nrow(d1_long), "rows,", n_distinct(d1_long$id), "unique patient IDs (NOT unique across centres),", 
    n_distinct(d1_long$patient_uid), "unique patients (Centre + id, i.e. patient_uid)\n")
```
### Patient-level swelling metrics
```{r swelling-metrics}
# SAP helper functions
vol_to_radius_cm <- function(V_cm3) (3 * V_cm3 / (4 * pi))^(1/3)

compute_swelling_metrics <- function(df,
                                     id_var   = "id",
                                     frac_var = "fraction",
                                     vol_var  = "vol_cm3") {
  df |>
    arrange(.data[[id_var]], .data[[frac_var]]) |>
    group_by(.data[[id_var]]) |>
    mutate(
      r_cm     = vol_to_radius_cm(.data[[vol_var]]),
      r1_cm    = first(r_cm),
      dr_mm    = (r_cm - r1_cm) * 10,
      frac_num = row_number()
    ) |>
    ungroup() |>
    group_by(.data[[id_var]]) |>
    summarise(
      baseline_vol_cm3 = first(.data[[vol_var]]),
      peak_dr_mm       = max(dr_mm, na.rm = TRUE),
      burden_3mm       = sum(dr_mm >= 3, na.rm = TRUE),
      burden_1mm       = sum(dr_mm >= 1, na.rm = TRUE),
      frac_first_3mm   = if (any(dr_mm >= 3, na.rm = TRUE))
                           min(frac_num[dr_mm >= 3], na.rm = TRUE)
                         else NA_integer_,
      mean_dr_first5   = mean(dr_mm[frac_num <= 5], na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups          = "drop"
    ) |>
    mutate(peak_dr_mm = if_else(is.infinite(peak_dr_mm), NA_real_, peak_dr_mm))
}

# MOMENTUM
mom_swelling <- compute_swelling_metrics(
  momentum_combined |> filter(Cohort == "MOM", !is.na(Volume)),
  id_var = "Patient_Id", frac_var = "Fraction", vol_var = "Volume"
) |> mutate(Cohort = "MOM")

# D1 (CentreA + CentreC only)
d1_swelling <- d1_long |>
  filter(as.character(Centre) %in% c("centreA", "centreC")) |>
  compute_swelling_metrics(
    id_var = "patient_uid", frac_var = "Fraction", vol_var = "Volume"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    Cohort = "D1",
    Centre = sub("_[^_]*$", "", patient_uid),
    id     = as.numeric(sub(".*_", "", patient_uid))
  )

# Unified swelling object
swelling <- bind_rows(
  mom_swelling,
  d1_swelling |> rename(Patient_Id = patient_uid)
)

momentum_combined <- momentum_combined |>
  left_join(
    swelling |> select(Patient_Id, Cohort,
                       peak_dr_mm, burden_3mm, burden_1mm,
                       frac_first_3mm, mean_dr_first5),
    by = c("Patient_Id", "Cohort")
  )

cat("Swelling metrics calculated:\n")
cat("  MOMENTUM:", nrow(mom_swelling), "patients\n")
cat("  D1 (CentreA+CentreC):", nrow(d1_swelling), "patients\n\n")

# Cohort comparison table
bind_rows(
  mom_swelling |> mutate(cohort = "MOMENTUM"),
  d1_swelling  |> rename(Patient_Id = patient_uid) |> mutate(cohort = "D1")
) |>
  group_by(cohort) |>
  summarise(
    n_patients                          = n(),
    median_peak_dr                      = round(median(peak_dr_mm, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    iqr_peak_dr                         = paste0(
                                            round(quantile(peak_dr_mm, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
                                            "-",
                                            round(quantile(peak_dr_mm, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE), 2)
                                          ),
    pct_peak_dr_3mm       = round(mean(peak_dr_mm >= 3, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1),
    pct_peak_dr_1mm       = round(mean(peak_dr_mm >= 1, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1),
    median_burden_3mm     = median(burden_3mm, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_mean_dr_first5 = round(median(mean_dr_first5, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  setNames(c("Cohort", "n", "Median peak dr (mm)", "IQR peak dr (mm)",
             "Pct peak dr >= 3mm", "Pct peak dr >= 1mm", "Median burden (>=3mm)",
             "Median mean dr fracs 1-5 (mm)"))
```

## CONSORT Flow Diagram
```{r consort-diagram}
library(ggplot2)

n_total     <- n_distinct(momentum_combined$Patient_Id)
n_mom       <- n_distinct(momentum_combined$Patient_Id[momentum_combined$Cohort == "MOM"])
n_d1        <- n_distinct(momentum_combined$Patient_Id[momentum_combined$Cohort == "D1"])
n_obs_mom   <- sum(!is.na(momentum_combined$Volume) &
                   momentum_combined$Fraction <= 5 &
                   momentum_combined$Cohort == "MOM")

n_mom_excl      <- 1L
n_obs_mom_excl  <- 1L
n_d1_sw         <- nrow(d1_swelling)
n_d1_centreB_excl   <- n_d1 - n_d1_sw

box <- function(x, y, w, h, label) data.frame(x = x, y = y, w = w, h = h, label = label)

consort_boxes <- rbind(
  box(2.2,  12.3, 4.2, 1.5, sprintf("Dest 1 cohort enrolled\nn = %d\n(20 per centre: CentreA, CentreB, CentreC)", n_d1)),
  box(8.2,  12.3, 4.2, 1.3, sprintf("MOMENTUM SBRT cohort identified\nn = %d", n_mom_pre_sap_excl)),

  box(8.2,  9.7, 4.6, 2.0, sprintf("Excluded:\nT-stage T3/T4, n = %d\nBaseline PSA > 20 ng/mL, n = %d\nGleason Grade Group 4/5, n = %d\n(criteria overlap)\nn = %d unique patients excluded", n_excl_stage_only, n_excl_psa_only, n_excl_gg_only, n_excl_sap_total)),

  box(2.2,  7.0, 4.2, 1.9, sprintf("Excluded from swelling analysis:\nCentreB, n = %d\naggregate-level data only,\nprecludes patient-level metrics", n_d1_centreB_excl)),
  box(8.2,  7.0, 4.2, 1.9, sprintf("Excluded:\nn = %d patient (>500%% volume increase, outlier)\nn = %d fraction-level observation\n(likely contouring/entry error)", n_mom_excl, n_obs_mom_excl)),

  box(2.2,  3.9, 4.2, 1.4, sprintf("Dest 1 swelling analysis cohort\nn = %d (CentreA + CentreC)", n_d1_sw)),
  box(8.2,  3.9, 4.2, 1.6, sprintf("MOMENTUM analysis cohort\nn = %d\nn = %s fraction-level observations\n(fractions 1\u20135)", n_mom, formatC(n_obs_mom, big.mark = ","))),

  box(5.2,  1.2, 5.2, 1.5, sprintf("Combined dataset\nn = %d patients\n(Dest 1 n = %d, MOMENTUM n = %d)", n_total, n_d1, n_mom))
)

b_top <- function(i) consort_boxes$y[i] + consort_boxes$h[i] / 2
b_bot <- function(i) consort_boxes$y[i] - consort_boxes$h[i] / 2
b_x   <- function(i) consort_boxes$x[i]

consort_arrows <- data.frame(
  x    = c(b_x(1), b_x(2), b_x(3), b_x(4), b_x(5), b_x(6), b_x(7)),
  xend = c(b_x(4), b_x(3), b_x(5), b_x(6), b_x(7), 4.5,    5.9),
  y    = c(b_bot(1), b_bot(2), b_bot(3), b_bot(4), b_bot(5), b_bot(6), b_bot(7)),
  yend = c(b_top(4), b_top(3), b_top(5), b_top(6), b_top(7), b_top(8), b_top(8))
)

consort_text_regular <- consort_boxes |> filter(y != 3.9)
consort_text_d1_note <- consort_boxes |> filter(y == 3.9)

p_consort <- ggplot() +
  geom_rect(data = consort_boxes, aes(xmin = x - w/2, xmax = x + w/2, ymin = y - h/2, ymax = y + h/2),
            fill = "white", colour = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_text(data = consort_text_regular, aes(x = x, y = y, label = label), size = 3.1, lineheight = 0.9) +
  geom_text(data = consort_text_d1_note, aes(x = x, y = y, label = label), size = 2.7, lineheight = 0.9) +
  geom_segment(data = consort_arrows, aes(x = x, xend = xend, y = y, yend = yend),
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.12, "inches")), linewidth = 0.4) +
  xlim(-0.2, 10.8) + ylim(-0.2, 13.5) +
  labs(title = "CONSORT Flow Diagram: Dest 1 and MOMENTUM SBRT Cohorts") +
  theme_void() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 13),
        plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10))

consort_png <- file.path(output_dir, "consort_flow_diagram.png")
ggsave(consort_png, p_consort, width = 9, height = 8.4, dpi = 300)

cat("\u2713 CONSORT diagram built (p_consort, consort_png)\n")
print(consort_png)
```

## D1 Swelling by Centre: Mean +/- 1 SD
```{r d1-sd-by-centre, fig.width=12, fig.height=6}
d1_changes <- d1_long |>
  group_by(Centre, id) |>
  mutate(
    fx1_vol    = first(Volume[Fraction == 1]),
    abs_change = Volume - fx1_vol,
    pct_change = (Volume - fx1_vol) / fx1_vol * 100
  ) |>
  ungroup()

d1_centre_n <- d1_changes |>
  distinct(Centre, id) |>
  count(Centre) |>
  mutate(Centre = factor(Centre, levels = c("centreA", "centreC", "centreB"))) |>
  arrange(Centre) |>
  mutate(centre_label = factor(
    paste0(toupper(as.character(Centre)), "\n(n=", n, ")"),
    levels = unique(paste0(toupper(as.character(Centre)), "\n(n=", n, ")"))
  ))

d1_centre_summary <- d1_changes |>
  group_by(Centre, Fraction) |>
  summarise(
    mean_abs = mean(abs_change, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_abs   = sd(abs_change, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_pct = mean(pct_change, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_pct   = sd(pct_change, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  left_join(d1_centre_n, by = "Centre")

p_d1_abs_sd <- ggplot(d1_centre_summary, aes(x = Fraction)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = mean_abs - sd_abs, ymax = mean_abs + sd_abs),
              fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.25) +
  geom_line(aes(y = mean_abs), color = "steelblue", linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_point(aes(y = mean_abs), color = "steelblue", size = 2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40") +
  facet_wrap(~ centre_label, nrow = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:5) +
  labs(
    title = "Dest 1: Mean Absolute Volume Change from Fraction 1 by Centre (+/- 1 SD)",
    x = "Fraction Number",
    y = "Absolute Volume Change (cm3)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold")
  )

p_d1_pct_sd <- ggplot(d1_centre_summary, aes(x = Fraction)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = mean_pct - sd_pct, ymax = mean_pct + sd_pct),
              fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.25) +
```

## MOMENTUM Swelling; All Centres Combined
```{r momentum-data-prep, include=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)

mom_outlier_excluded_id <- "<patient_id_1>"
mom_outlier_fx2_id      <- "<patient_id_2>"

momentum_combined <- momentum_combined |>
  filter(!(Patient_Id == mom_outlier_fx2_id & Fraction == 2))

momentum_volume_data <- momentum_combined |>
  filter(!is.na(Volume), Fraction <= 5, Patient_Id != mom_outlier_excluded_id) |>
  select(Patient_Id, Fraction, Volume) |>
  mutate(Fraction = as.numeric(Fraction))

momentum_pct_data <- momentum_combined |>
  filter(!is.na(Volume), Fraction <= 5, Patient_Id != mom_outlier_excluded_id) |>
  select(Patient_Id, Fraction, Volume) |>
  mutate(Fraction = as.numeric(Fraction)) |>
  group_by(Patient_Id) |>
  mutate(
    fx1_vol = first(Volume[Fraction == 1]),
    pct_change = round((Volume - fx1_vol) / fx1_vol * 100, 1)
  ) |>
  ungroup()
```
### Line Charts: Absolute and Percentage Volume Change by Centre (Mean +/- 1 SD)
```{r momentum-line-centre, fig.width=14, fig.height=9}
# Patient-level changes
mom_patient_changes <- momentum_combined |>
  filter(!is.na(Volume), Fraction <= 5, Patient_Id != mom_outlier_excluded_id) |>
  select(Patient_Id, Institution, Fraction, Volume) |>
  mutate(Fraction = as.numeric(Fraction)) |>
  group_by(Patient_Id, Institution) |>
  mutate(
    fx1_vol    = first(Volume[Fraction == 1]),
    abs_change = Volume - fx1_vol,
    pct_change = (Volume - fx1_vol) / fx1_vol * 100
  ) |>
  ungroup()

centre_n <- mom_patient_changes |>
  distinct(Institution, Patient_Id) |>
  count(Institution) |>
  mutate(centre_label = paste0(Institution, "\n(n=", n, ")"))

centres_to_keep <- centre_n |>
  filter(n > 10) |>
  pull(Institution)

mom_patient_changes_filtered <- mom_patient_changes |>
  filter(Institution %in% centres_to_keep)

centre_n <- centre_n |>
  filter(Institution %in% centres_to_keep)

mom_centre_summary <- mom_patient_changes_filtered |>
  group_by(Institution, Fraction) |>
  summarise(
    mean_abs = mean(abs_change, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_abs   = sd(abs_change, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_pct = mean(pct_change, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_pct   = sd(pct_change, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  left_join(centre_n, by = "Institution")
```

### Mean +/- IQR
```{r momentum-mean-iqr, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
# Calculate summary statistics
summary_stats <- momentum_pct_data |>
  group_by(Fraction) |>
  summarise(
    Mean = round(mean(pct_change, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    Median = round(median(pct_change, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    SD = round(sd(pct_change, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    Q1 = round(quantile(pct_change, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    Q3 = round(quantile(pct_change, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(summary_stats, aes(x = Fraction, y = Mean)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = Q1, ymax = Q3), alpha = 0.3, fill = "steelblue") +
  geom_line(color = "steelblue", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 3, color = "steelblue") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:7) +
  labs(
    title = "MOMENTUM: Mean % Change from Fraction 1 with IQR Band",
    x = "Fraction Number",
    y = "% Change from Fraction 1"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"))
```
```{r median-iqr-flextable, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE}

library(flextable)

d1_summary <- d1_changes |>
  filter(!is.na(Volume)) |>
  group_by(Fraction) |>
  summarise(
    d1_median = median(Volume),
    d1_q1     = quantile(Volume, 0.25),
    d1_q3     = quantile(Volume, 0.75),
    d1_n      = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    `D1 (n)`          = paste0(d1_n),
    `D1 Median (IQR) cm3` = paste0(
      round(d1_median, 1), " (", round(d1_q1, 1), " to ", round(d1_q3, 1), ")"
    )
  )

mom_summary <- mom_patient_changes |>
  filter(!is.na(Volume)) |>
  group_by(Fraction) |>
  summarise(
    mom_median = median(Volume),
    mom_q1     = quantile(Volume, 0.25),
    mom_q3     = quantile(Volume, 0.75),
    mom_n      = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    `MOMENTUM (n)`          = paste0(mom_n),
    `MOMENTUM Median (IQR) cm3` = paste0(
      round(mom_median, 1), " (", round(mom_q1, 1), " to ", round(mom_q3, 1), ")"
    )
  )

# Combine
summary_table <- d1_summary |>
  full_join(mom_summary, by = "Fraction") |>
  arrange(Fraction) |>
  select(
    Fraction,
    `D1 (n)`,
    `D1 Median (IQR) cm3`,
    `MOMENTUM (n)`,
    `MOMENTUM Median (IQR) cm3`
  )

# Build flextable
ft_median_iqr_abs <- flextable(summary_table) |>
  set_header_labels(Fraction = "Fraction") |>
  add_header_row(
    values = c("", "Dest 1 (3 centres combined)", "MOMENTUM (cleaned)"),
    colwidths = c(1, 2, 2)
  ) |>
  theme_booktabs() |>
  align(align = "center", part = "all") |>
  align(j = 1, align = "center", part = "all") |>
  bold(part = "header") |>
  set_caption("Median absolute prostate volume (cm3) with IQR, by fraction") |>
  autofit()

ft_median_iqr_abs

# Save as standalone Word document
save_docx(

  path = file.path(output_dir, "median_iqr_abs_volume_table.docx")
)
```

```{r momentum-heatmap, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
momentum_pct_binned <- momentum_pct_data |>
```

```{r swelling-summary-output, fig.width=12, fig.height=6}
library(flextable)

delta <- "\u0394"; ge <- "\u2265"; en <- "\u2013"

# Swelling comparison flextable
swelling_ft_data <- bind_rows(
  mom_swelling |> mutate(cohort = "MOMENTUM"),
  d1_swelling  |> dplyr::rename(Patient_Id = patient_uid) |> mutate(cohort = "D1")
) |>
  dplyr::group_by(cohort) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    n               = as.character(n()),
    med_peak        = as.character(round(median(peak_dr_mm, na.rm = TRUE), 2)),
    iqr_peak        = paste0(round(quantile(peak_dr_mm, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE), 2), en,
                             round(quantile(peak_dr_mm, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE), 2)),
    pct_ge3         = as.character(round(mean(peak_dr_mm >= 3, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1)),
    pct_ge1         = as.character(round(mean(peak_dr_mm >= 1, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1)),
    med_burden3     = as.character(median(burden_3mm, na.rm = TRUE)),
    med_mean_first5 = as.character(round(median(mean_dr_first5, na.rm = TRUE), 2)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(-cohort, names_to = "key", values_to = "val") |>

  dplyr::mutate(Metric = dplyr::case_match(key,
    "n"               ~ "n (patients)",
    "med_peak"        ~ paste0("Median peak ", delta, "r (mm)"),
    "iqr_peak"        ~ paste0("IQR peak ", delta, "r (mm)"),
    "pct_ge3"         ~ paste0("% with peak ", delta, "r ", ge, " 3 mm"),
    "pct_ge1"         ~ paste0("% with peak ", delta, "r ", ge, " 1 mm"),
    "med_burden3"     ~ paste0("Median burden (fractions ", ge, " 3 mm)"),
    "med_mean_first5" ~ paste0("Median mean ", delta, "r, fractions 1", en, "5 (mm)")
  )) |>
  dplyr::select(Metric, D1, MOMENTUM)

ft_swelling_summary <- flextable(swelling_ft_data) |>

  bg(part = "header", bg = "#1F4E79") |>
```

## SAP Analysis
### Build d1_model (SAP Section 5.1)
```{r sap-d1-model-build}
library(tidyverse)
library(flextable)
library(officer)

d1_model <- d1 |>
  filter(Centre %in% c("centreC", "centreA")) |>
  inner_join(
    d1_swelling |> select(id, Centre, baseline_vol_cm3, peak_dr_mm, burden_3mm, burden_1mm),
    by = c("id", "Centre")
  ) |>
  mutate(
    GU_G2_12w = as.integer(gu_ge2_by_wk12),
    ADT       = if_else(adt == "Y", 1L, 0L),
    centre    = factor(Centre, levels = c("centreC", "centreA"))
  ) |>
  select(
    id, centre, GU_G2_12w, baseline_vol_cm3,
    ADT, IPSS_baseline = baseline_ipss_tot, age,
    peak_dr_mm, burden_3mm, burden_1mm
  ) |>
  # Unique character ID across centres
  mutate(id = paste0(centre, "_", id))

str(d1_model)
```
### SAP Step 2: Pre-processing (SAP Section 5.3)
```{r sap-preprocessing}
d1_model <- d1_model |>
  mutate(
    baseline_vol_c = baseline_vol_cm3 - median(baseline_vol_cm3, na.rm = TRUE),
    IPSS_c         = IPSS_baseline    - median(IPSS_baseline,    na.rm = TRUE),
    age_c          = age              - median(age,              na.rm = TRUE),
    ADT_factor     = factor(ADT, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("No", "Yes")),
    centre_factor  = factor(centre)
  )

cat("Medians used for centring:\n")
cat("  baseline_vol_cm3:", median(d1_model$baseline_vol_cm3), "cm3\n")
cat("  IPSS_baseline:   ", median(d1_model$IPSS_baseline), "\n")
cat("  age:             ", median(d1_model$age), "years\n")
```
### SAP Step 3: Pre-modelling checks (SAP Section 5.4, 5.7)
```{r sap-premodelling-checks}
# Events and EPV
cat("Outcome counts:\n")
print(table(d1_model$GU_G2_12w))

n_events         <- sum(d1_model$GU_G2_12w == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
n_params_primary <- 1 + 1
EPV              <- n_events / n_params_primary
cat("\nEvents:", n_events, "| Parameters:", n_params_primary, "| EPV:", round(EPV, 1), "\n")
cat("(Original 4-param model EPV:", round(n_events / 4, 1), "-- below conventional threshold of 10)\n")

# Separation check (SAP Section 5.4)
cat("\nSeparation check - burden_3mm vs GU_G2_12w:\n")
cat("NOTE: burden_3mm = 0 for all", nrow(d1_model), "patients -- zero variance; Model A dropped.\n")

cat("\nSeparation check - burden_1mm vs GU_G2_12w:\n")
print(with(d1_model, table(burden_1mm, GU_G2_12w)))
```
### SAP Section 6.1: D1 Descriptives
#### Table 1: Baseline characteristics; D1 and MOMENTUM combined
```{r sap-combined-baseline}
med_iqr <- function(x) {
  x <- as.numeric(x); x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  if (length(x) == 0) return("N/A \u2021")
  sprintf("%.1f (%.1f\u2013%.1f)", median(x), quantile(x, 0.25), quantile(x, 0.75))
}

adt_fmt <- function(x) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x) & x != "NA"]
  if (length(x) == 0) return("N/A \u2021")
  yes <- sum(x %in% c("Y", "Yes"), na.rm = TRUE)
  sprintf("%d/%d (%.0f%%)", yes, length(x), 100 * yes / length(x))
}

gu_fmt <- function(x) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  if (length(x) == 0) return("N/A \u2021")
  sprintf("%d/%d (%.0f%%)", sum(x, na.rm = TRUE), length(x), 100 * mean(x, na.rm = TRUE))
}

# D1 subsets
d1_centreC <- d1 |> filter(Centre == "centreC")
d1_centreA <- d1 |> filter(Centre == "centreA")
d1_centreB <- d1 |> filter(Centre == "centreB")

# MOMENTUM patient-level data
mom_pts_tbl <- momentum_combined |>
  filter(Cohort == "MOM") |>
  distinct(Patient_Id, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  mutate(adt_use_clean = case_when(
    ADT_Use %in% c("Yes", "Y") ~ "Yes",
    ADT_Use %in% c("No",  "N") ~ "No",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  ))

mom_vol <- mom_swelling |> pull(baseline_vol_cm3)

t_known <- mom_pts_tbl |>
  filter(!is.na(T_STAGE_GROUP), !T_STAGE_GROUP %in% c("Other", "Tx"))
t_fmt <- function(stage) {
  n <- sum(t_known$T_STAGE_GROUP == stage, na.rm = TRUE)
  sprintf("%d/%d (%.0f%%)", n, nrow(t_known), 100 * n / nrow(t_known))
}

gg_known <- mom_pts_tbl |>
  filter(!is.na(PRE_C61_GLEASON_SCORE_PRIMARY), !is.na(PRE_C61_GLEASON_SCORE_SECONDARY)) |>
  mutate(
    gleason_primary   = as.numeric(PRE_C61_GLEASON_SCORE_PRIMARY),
    gleason_secondary = as.numeric(PRE_C61_GLEASON_SCORE_SECONDARY),
    gleason_total      = gleason_primary + gleason_secondary,
    grade_group = case_when(
      gleason_primary <= 3 & gleason_secondary <= 3 ~ "GG1",
      gleason_primary == 3 & gleason_secondary == 4 ~ "GG2",
      gleason_primary == 4 & gleason_secondary == 3 ~ "GG3",
      gleason_total == 8                             ~ "GG4",
      gleason_total >= 9                             ~ "GG5",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(grade_group))
gg_fmt <- function(gg) {
  n <- sum(gg_known$grade_group == gg, na.rm = TRUE)
  sprintf("%s: %d/%d (%.0f%%)", gg, n, nrow(gg_known), 100 * n / nrow(gg_known))
}
gg_groups_present <- sort(unique(gg_known$grade_group))
gg_mom_str <- paste(sapply(gg_groups_present, gg_fmt), collapse = " | ")

tbl_combined <- bind_rows(list(

  tibble(Variable = "n",
    CentreC        = "20",
    CentreA = "20",
    CentreB        = "20",
    MOMENTUM   = format(n_distinct(mom_pts_tbl$Patient_Id), big.mark = ",")),

  tibble(Variable = "Age, years: median (IQR)",
    CentreC        = med_iqr(d1_centreC$age),
    CentreA = med_iqr(d1_centreA$age),
    CentreB        = "69 (64\u201372)",
    MOMENTUM   = med_iqr(mom_pts_tbl$AGE_DIAGNOSIS)),

  tibble(Variable = "Baseline prostate CTV volume (Fx1 scan), cm3: median (IQR)",
    CentreC        = med_iqr(d1_centreC$fx1_ctv_vol),
    CentreA = med_iqr(d1_centreA$fx1_ctv_vol),
    CentreB        = med_iqr(d1_centreB$fx1_ctv_vol),
    MOMENTUM   = med_iqr(mom_vol)),

  tibble(Variable = "Baseline PSA, ng/mL: median (IQR)",
    CentreC        = med_iqr(d1_centreC$baseline_psa),
    CentreA = med_iqr(d1_centreA$baseline_psa),
    CentreB        = "N/A \u2021",
    MOMENTUM   = med_iqr(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(mom_pts_tbl$PRE_C61_PSA)))),

  tibble(Variable = "Gleason Grade Group: n/N (%)",
    CentreC        = "GG1: 2/20 (10%) | GG2: 17/20 (85%) | GG3: 1/20 (5%)",
    CentreA = "GG1: 0/20 (0%) | GG2: 17/20 (85%) | GG3: 3/20 (15%)",
    CentreB        = "GG1: 1/20 (5%) | GG2: 12/20 (60%) | GG3: 7/20 (35%)",
    MOMENTUM   = gg_mom_str),

  tibble(Variable = "ADT use: n/N with data (%)",
    CentreC        = adt_fmt(d1_centreC$adt),
    CentreA = adt_fmt(d1_centreA$adt),
    CentreB        = "4/20 (20%)",
    MOMENTUM   = sprintf("%d/%d (%.0f%%)",
                   sum(mom_pts_tbl$adt_use_clean == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE),
                   sum(!is.na(mom_pts_tbl$adt_use_clean)),
                   100 * mean(mom_pts_tbl$adt_use_clean == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE))),

  tibble(Variable = "Baseline IPSS: median (IQR)",
    CentreC        = med_iqr(d1_centreC$baseline_ipss_tot),
    CentreA = med_iqr(d1_centreA$baseline_ipss_tot),
    CentreB        = "3.5 (2\u20139.5)",
    MOMENTUM   = "N/A"),

  tibble(Variable = "T stage (n with data)",
    CentreC = "20", CentreA = "20", CentreB = "20",
    MOMENTUM = as.character(nrow(t_known))),
  tibble(Variable = "  T1/cT1c",
    CentreC = sprintf("%d/20 (%.0f%%)", sum(d1_centreC$t_stage=="1A"), 100*mean(d1_centreC$t_stage=="1A")),
    CentreA = sprintf("%d/20 (%.0f%%)", sum(d1_centreA$t_stage=="T1c"), 100*mean(d1_centreA$t_stage=="T1c")),
    CentreB = "13/20 (65%)",
    MOMENTUM = sprintf("%d/%d (%.0f%%)", sum(t_known$T_STAGE_GROUP=="T1"), nrow(t_known), 100*sum(t_known$T_STAGE_GROUP=="T1")/nrow(t_known))),
  tibble(Variable = "  T2/cT2a-b",
    CentreC = sprintf("%d/20 (%.0f%%)", sum(d1_centreC$t_stage=="2"), 100*mean(d1_centreC$t_stage=="2")),
    CentreA = sprintf("%d/20 (%.0f%%)", sum(d1_centreA$t_stage %in% c("T2a","T2b")), 100*mean(d1_centreA$t_stage %in% c("T2a","T2b"))),
    CentreB = "7/20 (35%)",
    MOMENTUM = sprintf("%d/%d (%.0f%%)", sum(t_known$T_STAGE_GROUP=="T2"), nrow(t_known), 100*sum(t_known$T_STAGE_GROUP=="T2")/nrow(t_known))),
  tibble(Variable = "  T3",
    CentreC = "0/20 (0%)",
    CentreA = "0/20 (0%)",
    CentreB = "0/20 (0%)",
    MOMENTUM = sprintf("%d/%d (%.0f%%)", sum(t_known$T_STAGE_GROUP=="T3"), nrow(t_known), 100*sum(t_known$T_STAGE_GROUP=="T3")/nrow(t_known))),
  tibble(Variable = "  T4",
    CentreC = "0/20 (0%)",
    CentreA = "0/20 (0%)",
    CentreB = "0/20 (0%)",
    MOMENTUM = sprintf("%d/%d (%.0f%%)", sum(t_known$T_STAGE_GROUP=="T4"), nrow(t_known), 100*sum(t_known$T_STAGE_GROUP=="T4")/nrow(t_known))),

  tibble(Variable = "GU \u2265 Grade 2 at 12 wk: n/N (%)",
    CentreC        = gu_fmt(d1_centreC$gu_ge2_by_wk12),
    CentreA = gu_fmt(d1_centreA$gu_ge2_by_wk12),
    CentreB        = "9/20 (45%) \u2020",
    MOMENTUM   = "N/A"),

  tibble(Variable = "T stage (n with data)",
    CentreC = "N/A \u2021", CentreA = "N/A \u2021", CentreB = "N/A \u2021",
    MOMENTUM = as.character(nrow(t_known))),
  tibble(Variable = "  T1",
    CentreC = "N/A \u2021", CentreA = "N/A \u2021", CentreB = "N/A \u2021",
    MOMENTUM = t_fmt("T1")),
  tibble(Variable = "  T2",
    CentreC = "N/A \u2021", CentreA = "N/A \u2021", CentreB = "N/A \u2021",
    MOMENTUM = t_fmt("T2")),
  tibble(Variable = "  T3",

))
```

```{r sap-swelling-by-centre, fig.width=9, fig.height=5}
make_sw_panel <- function(dat, ylab) {
  ggplot(dat, aes(x = Centre_label, y = value)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.4, colour = "grey50", fill = NA) +
    geom_jitter(aes(colour = Centre_label), width = 0.13, height = 0,
                size = 1.6, alpha = 0.5) +
    facet_wrap(~metric) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c("CentreC" = "#E69F00", "CentreA" = "#56B4E9",
                                   "MOMENTUM" = "#009E73")) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = scales::breaks_width(1), limits = c(0, 6.3)) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = ylab) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    theme(legend.position = "none",
          strip.background = element_rect(fill = "#1F4E79"),
          strip.text = element_text(colour = "white", face = "bold"),
          panel.grid.major.x = element_blank())
}

set.seed(2847)
p_sw_peak   <- make_sw_panel(filter(sw_centre_long, metric == levels(metric)[1]), "Millimetres (mm)")
p_sw_burden <- make_sw_panel(filter(sw_centre_long, metric == levels(metric)[2]), "Number of fractions")

p_d1_sw_centre <- (p_sw_peak | p_sw_burden) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Swelling metrics by centre: Dest 1 cohort and MOMENTUM reference",
    subtitle = sprintf("CentreC n = %d, CentreA n = %d, MOMENTUM n = %s. CentreB excluded (no per-fraction volume data).\nBoxes show IQR and median. MOMENTUM is a descriptive reference only.",
                       n_centreC_sw, n_centreA_sw, format(n_mom_sw, big.mark = ",")),
    theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 15), plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12))
  )
```

#### Delta r trajectories by ADT status (SAP Section 6.1)
```{r sap-adt-trajectories, fig.width=9, fig.height=5}
d1_long_adt <- d1_long |>
  left_join(d1 |> select(id, Centre, adt), by = c("id", "Centre")) |>
  group_by(id, Centre) |>
  mutate(
    r_mm    = ((3 * Volume / (4 * pi))^(1/3)) * 10,
    r_fx1   = r_mm[Fraction == 1],
    delta_r = r_mm - r_fx1
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(adt_label = case_when(
    adt == "Y"  ~ "ADT: Yes",
    adt == "N"  ~ "ADT: No",
    is.na(adt)  ~ "ADT: Unknown"
  ))

adt_summary <- d1_long_adt |>
  filter(adt %in% c("N","Y")) |>
  group_by(adt_label, Fraction) |>
  summarise(mean_dr = mean(delta_r, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

set.seed(7234)
p_adt_traj <- ggplot(
    d1_long_adt |> filter(adt %in% c("N","Y")),
    aes(x = Fraction, y = delta_r, group = interaction(id, Centre))
  ) +
  geom_line(aes(colour = Centre), alpha = 0.35, linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_line(data = adt_summary,
            aes(x = Fraction, y = mean_dr, group = adt_label),
            colour = "black", linewidth = 1.1, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_point(data = adt_summary,
             aes(x = Fraction, y = mean_dr),
             colour = "black", size = 2, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~ adt_label) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:5) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(centreC = "blue", centreA = "#D55E00", centreB = "forestgreen"),
                      labels = c(centreC = "CentreC", centreA = "CentreA", centreB = "CentreB")) +

       title = "Prostate radius change (\u0394r) by ADT status \u2014 Dest 1 cohort",
       subtitle = "Light lines = individual patients (colour by centre). Black line = group mean.",
       colour = "Centre") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill = "#1F4E79"),
```

```{r regression-tables}

extract_glm <- function(model, model_label) {
  coefs  <- coef(model)
  se     <- sqrt(diag(vcov(model)))
  z      <- coefs / se
  p_wald <- 2 * pnorm(abs(z), lower.tail = FALSE)
  ci_lo  <- coefs - 1.96 * se
  ci_hi  <- coefs + 1.96 * se

  tibble(
    Model = model_label,
    Term = names(coefs),
    OR = exp(coefs),
    CI_low = exp(ci_lo),
    CI_high = exp(ci_hi),
    p_value = p_wald
  ) |>
    filter(Term != "(Intercept)") |>
    mutate(
      Term = recode(
        Term,
        "peak_dr_mm" = "Peak Δr (per 1 mm)",
        "baseline_vol_c" = "Baseline prostate volume (per 1 cm3)",
        "ADT_factorYes" = "ADT (Yes vs No)",
        "IPSS_c" = "Baseline IPSS (per 1 point)"
      ),
      `OR (95% CI)` = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f–%.2f)", OR, CI_low, CI_high),
      `Wald p-value` = sprintf("%.3f", p_value)
    ) |>
    select(Model, Term, `OR (95% CI)`, `Wald p-value`)
}

# ---- Table 2a: Primary model --------------------------------------------

table2a <- extract_glm(
  modelC,
  "Primary model: peak Δr + baseline volume"
)

# ---- Table 2b: Sensitivity models ---------------------------------------

table2b <- bind_rows(
  extract_glm(
    modelC_adt,
    "Sensitivity: peak Δr + baseline volume + ADT"
  ),
  extract_glm(
    modelC_ipss,
    "Sensitivity: peak Δr + baseline volume + baseline IPSS"
  )
)
```

```{r power-calculation, eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}

# Simulation-based detectable-effect analysis (Model C)

set.seed(20260908)

n_sim <- 5000
alpha <- 0.05

x_peak <- d1_model$peak_dr_mm
x_vol  <- d1_model$baseline_vol_c

n_patients <- nrow(d1_model)
event_rate <- mean(d1_model$GU_G2_12w)

or_grid <- seq(1.00, 10.00, by = 0.01)

power_at_or <- function(or_peak) {
  
  beta_peak <- log(or_peak)
  
  intercept <- uniroot(
    function(beta_0) {
      mean(plogis(beta_0 + beta_peak * x_peak + 0 * x_vol)) - event_rate
    },
    interval = c(-20, 20)
  )$root
  
  p_event <- plogis(intercept + beta_peak * x_peak + 0 * x_vol)
  
  p_values <- replicate(n_sim, {
    y <- rbinom(n_patients, size = 1, prob = p_event)
    
    fit <- glm(
      y ~ x_peak + x_vol,
      family = binomial(link = "logit")
    )
    
    coef_summary <- summary(fit)$coefficients
    
    if ("x_peak" %in% rownames(coef_summary)) {
      coef_summary["x_peak", "Pr(>|z|)"]
    } else {
      NA_real_
    }
  })
  
  mean(p_values < alpha, na.rm = TRUE)
}

power_df <- tibble(
  OR = or_grid,
  Power = vapply(or_grid, power_at_or, numeric(1))
)

mdor_80 <- power_df |>
  filter(Power >= 0.80) |>
  slice(1) |>
  pull(OR)

if (length(mdor_80) == 0) {
  mdor_80 <- NA_real_
  warning("Empirical power did not reach 80% within the OR grid of 1.00 to 10.00.")
}

p_power_curve <- ggplot(power_df, aes(x = OR, y = Power)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8, colour = "#1F4E79") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.80, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40") +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = mdor_80,
    linetype = "dashed",
    colour = "#B22222",
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = mdor_80,
    y = 0.08,
    label = ifelse(
      is.na(mdor_80),
      "80% power not reached",
      sprintf("80%% power at OR = %.2f", mdor_80)
    ),
    hjust = -0.05,
    colour = "#B22222",
    size = 3.5
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(
    title = "Simulation-based detectable-effect analysis (Model C)",
    subtitle = sprintf(
      "n = %d; target event rate = %.1f%%; %d simulations per assumed odds ratio",
      n_patients, 100 * event_rate, n_sim
    ),
    x = "Assumed odds ratio per 1-mm increase in peak Δr",
    y = "Empirical power"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

tmp_power_curve <- file.path(tempdir(), "power_curve.png")

ggsave(
  tmp_power_curve,
  p_power_curve,
  width = 6,
  height = 4,
  dpi = 300
)

p_power_results <- if (is.na(mdor_80)) {
  sprintf(
    paste0(
      "Simulation-based detectable-effect analysis for Model C used %d simulations ",
      "for each assumed odds ratio, preserving the observed sample size (n = %d), ",
      "peak Δr distribution, centred baseline-volume distribution, and observed event ",
      "rate (%.1f%%). The analysis did not achieve 80%% empirical power for an odds ",
      "ratio up to 10.00 per 1-mm increase in peak Δr."
    ),
    n_sim, n_patients, 100 * event_rate
  )
} else {
  sprintf(
    paste0(
      "Simulation-based detectable-effect analysis for Model C used %d simulations ",
      "for each assumed odds ratio, preserving the observed sample size (n = %d), ",
      "peak Δr distribution, centred baseline-volume distribution, and observed event ",
      "rate (%.1f%%). The smallest assumed odds ratio associated with at least 80%% ",
      "empirical power was %.2f per 1-mm increase in peak Δr."
    ),
    n_sim, n_patients, 100 * event_rate, mdor_80
  )
}

print(p_power_curve)

cat(
  sprintf(
    "Minimum detectable OR at 80%% power: %s per 1-mm increase in peak Δr\n",
    ifelse(is.na(mdor_80), "not reached within OR 1.00–10.00", sprintf("%.2f", mdor_80))
  )
)
```

```{r sap-word-doc-save}
  "Deviation 1 \u2014 Model A (burden \u22653 mm) not fitted.\n",
  "The exposure burden_3mm was zero for all 40 patients in the modelling set \u2014 no patient ",
  "experienced radial expansion of \u22653 mm on any fraction. As a zero-variance predictor, ",
  "this exposure cannot be estimated and was not analysed. This deviation is declared per SAP Section 5.4.\n\n",
  "Deviation 2 \u2014 Post-hoc model simplification (primary models reduced from 4 to 2 predictors).\n",
  "The SAP pre-specified three covariates (baseline volume, ADT, IPSS) alongside the primary exposure. ",
  "With n = 40 patients and 21 events, the original 4-parameter model yielded EPV = 5.3. ",
  "To improve estimator stability, the primary model was simplified post-hoc to 2 parameters ",
  "(peak \u0394r + baseline prostate volume; EPV = 10.5). ADT and baseline IPSS were retained as separate ",
  "3-parameter sensitivity analyses (EPV = 7.0 each), not as additional primary hypothesis tests. ",
  "This deviation is declared per SAP Section 5.4.\n\n",
  "Deviation 3 \u2014 Patient numbers below SAP expectation.\n",
  "The SAP anticipated approximately 50 patients. The actual modelling set comprises 40 patients ",
  "(20 CentreC + 20 CentreA). EPV = 10.5 for the primary 2-parameter model. ",
  "This deviation is declared per SAP Section 5.4."
)

cat("\u2713 SAP images and deviation text prepared for combined write-up document\n")
```

```{r write-methods-docx}
# Software versions

# -- Text helper -------------------------------------------------------------

en  <- "\u2013"

delta <- "\u0394"

# -- Methods paragraphs -----------------------------------------------------

p_design <- sprintf(

    "The DESTINATION trial federated design has been previously described (7) (UK NCT06284304). ",
    "All patients provided written informed consent for inclusion in the trial and the MOMENTUM registry. ",
    "In brief, patients with localised prostate cancer, with an MRI-defined lesion and no occult ",
    "high-grade disease on biopsy with reasonable urinary function were eligible. The prescription dose was ",
    "30Gy/5# to the whole gland with no CTV to PTV margin and a simultaneous boost of 45Gy to the intraprostatic expansion of the GTV, ",
    "with isotoxic planning. %d centres enrolled %d patients each (%d in total) for treatment on the ",
    "Elekta Unity MR-linac with online adaptation on alternate days (Elekta, Stockholm); Centre C; ",
    "Centre A; and Centre B."
  ),
  n_d1_centres, n_per_centre, n_d1_total
)

p_sap <- paste0(
  "A Statistical Analysis Plan (SAP, version 1.0, eFile 1) was written and locked prior to analysis ",
  "in April 2026. All analyses reported here were pre-specified; deviations from the SAP are declared ",
  "explicitly in the relevant sections."
)

p_d1_cohort <- sprintf(
  paste0(
    "Individual-level per-fraction CTV volumes, baseline prostate volume, ADT status, baseline IPSS, and ",

    "could only contribute aggregate rather than individual level data. CentreB contributed per-fraction volume ",
    "data. A MOMENTUM data access request (DAR) for individual patient data from the CentreB Dest 1 patients ",
    "enrolled in the MOMENTUM registry was submitted to attempt enrichment to individual level data; ",
    "however this was non-informative and CentreB therefore contributed to descriptive analyses only."
  )
)

p_d1_modelling <- sprintf(

    "The final modelling dataset comprised %d patients (%d CentreC, %d CentreA)."
  ),
  n_modelling, n_centreC_model, n_centreA_model
)

p_momentum_cohort <- sprintf(
  paste0(
    "To contextualise the magnitude and pattern of Dest 1 swelling, data were drawn from the MOMENTUM registry, ",
    "restricted to patients treated with adapt-to-shape SBRT at 36.25-45 Gy in 5%s7 fractions ",
    "for T1-sT2 prostate cancer (PSA <20 ng/mL). Patients treated with moderate hypofractionation ",
    "(e.g. 10-fraction regimens at 36.25-s40 Gy) were excluded from all analyses. This cohort was used purely as a descriptive ",
    "reference; no inferential comparisons of swelling or AE outcomes between Dest 1 and MOMENTUM were performed. ",
    "Prostate CTV volumes were extracted from the MOMENTUM validation cohort planning system exports, in which ",
    "each fraction record contained pipe-delimited strings of ROI names paired with corresponding volumes. ",
    "Because ROI nomenclature varied substantially across institutions, for example \"Prostate\", \"Prostaat\", ",
    "\"Prostata\", \"CTV_Prostate\", and \"CTV3625\", a fuzzy string-matching approach was required to identify ",
    "the correct structure in each record. A reference table of accepted prostate ROI terms was constructed with ",
    "an explicit priority hierarchy (pure prostate structures first, CTV prostate variants second, ",
    "prostate-plus-seminal-vesicle terms third), and Jaro-Winkler distance matching was applied via the ",
    "fuzzyjoin package (max_dist = 3), selecting the highest-priority, closest-matching ROI per fraction. ",
    "The matched ROI name was then used to index into the corresponding volume string, with a regex fallback ",

p_analysis <- sprintf(

p_models <- sprintf(

    "Two sensitivity analyses separately added a single additional covariate to the primary model:\n",
    "Model C_ADT: Model C + ADT (Yes vs No)\n",
    "Model C_IPSS: Model C + baseline IPSS (centred)\n",
    "These sensitivity analyses assessed robustness of the primary estimate and were not treated as ",

p_power <- paste0(

)

p_deviations <- sprintf(
```

```{r results-text-prep}
p_cleaning <- "One MOMENTUM patient was excluded from all volume analyses due to extreme outlying (>500% increase in volume). A single fraction-level observation for a second patient (fraction 2, +81% from baseline reverting fully by fraction 3) was removed as a likely contouring or data entry error."

Age at diagnosis was recorded for %d MOMENTUM patients (%s%%), with a median of %d years (IQR %d\u2013%d). Pre-treatment PSA was available for %d MOMENTUM patients (%s%%), with some variation in data capture across contributing centres.",

The median number of fractions meeting the \u22652 mm threshold was 0, indicating that swelling of this magnitude was episodic rather than sustained in the majority.",
  fmt(n_mom), med_peak_mom, q1_peak_mom, q3_peak_mom, pct_ge2_mom, pct_ge1_mom)

p_swelling_d1 <- sprintf(

  n_d1_sw, med_peak_d1, q1_peak_d1, q3_peak_d1, pct_ge2_d1, pct_ge1_d1)

# AE outcomes
n_tox_events    <- sum(d1_model$GU_G2_12w == 1, na.rm = TRUE)

p_AE <- sprintf(
  "In the Dest 1 modelling cohort (n = %d; CentreA and CentreC), %d patients (%.1f%%) experienced acute GU AE of CTCAE Grade %s2 at 12 weeks (cumulative).",
  n_tox_total, n_tox_events, pct_tox_events, ge)

extract_primary_res <- function(model, exposure) {
  coefs <- coef(model)
  se    <- sqrt(diag(vcov(model)))
  idx   <- which(names(coefs) == exposure)
  est   <- coefs[idx]
  z     <- est / se[idx]
  list(
    or    = round(exp(est), 2),
    or_lo = round(exp(est - 1.96 * se[idx]), 2),
    or_hi = round(exp(est + 1.96 * se[idx]), 2),
    pval  = 2 * pnorm(abs(z), lower.tail = FALSE)
  )
}

fmt_p <- function(p) {
  if (p < 0.001) "p < 0.001" else sprintf("p = %.3f", p)
}

resC <- extract_primary_res(modelC, "peak_dr_mm")

epv_val <- round(n_tox_events / (length(coef(modelC)) - 1), 1)

epv_val_sens <- round(n_tox_events / (length(coef(modelC_adt)) - 1), 1)

p_premodel_results <- sprintf(
  paste0(
    "Pre-modelling checks were performed. With %d events and 2 model parameters (peak %sr + ",
    "baseline prostate volume), EPV was %.1f, above the conventional threshold of 10 and confirming ",
    "the appropriateness of standard maximum-likelihood logistic regression. Burden %s3 mm was zero ",
    "for all %d patients in the modelling set (Model A not estimable; Deviation 1). ",
    "The primary exposure for modelling was peak %sr."
  ),
  n_tox_events, delta, epv_val, ge, n_tox_total, delta
)

p_logistic_results <- sprintf(
  paste0(
    "Results from the primary standard logistic regression model are presented in Table 2a ",
    "(sensitivity models in Table 2b). In the primary model, peak %sr (mm) was not significantly ",
    "associated with acute GU AE %s G2 at 12 weeks (OR %.2f per 1-mm increase, 95%% CI %.2f\u2013%.2f; %s), ",
    "after adjustment for centred baseline prostate volume. Sensitivity analyses separately adding ADT ",
    "and baseline IPSS did not materially change this estimate. Confidence intervals were wide in all ",
    "models, reflecting the small sample size."
  ),
  delta, ge,
  resC$or, resC$or_lo, resC$or_hi, fmt_p(resC$pval)
)
```

```{r write-combined-docx}
tmp_figs <- lapply(seq_along(fig_list), function(i) {
  f <- file.path(tempdir(), paste0("fig_", i, ".png"))
  ggsave(f, fig_list[[i]]$obj, width = fig_list[[i]]$w, height = fig_list[[i]]$h, dpi = 300)
  f
})

library(flextable)
ft_primary <- flextable(table2a) |> autofit()
ft_sens    <- flextable(table2b) |> autofit()

# -- Build combined Word document --------------------------------------------
doc <- read_docx() |>
  body_add_par("CONSORT Flow Diagram", style = "heading 1") |>
  body_add_img(consort_png, width = 6.5, height = 6.5 * 8.4 / 9) |>

  # 2) Tables section
  body_add_par("Tables", style = "heading 1") |>
  body_add_par("Median Absolute Prostate Volume (cm3) by Fraction", style = "heading 2") |>
  body_add_flextable(ft_median_iqr_abs) |>
  body_add_par("Baseline Characteristics: Dest 1 and MOMENTUM SBRT Cohorts", style = "heading 2") |>
  body_add_flextable(ft_combined_baseline) |>
  body_add_par("Swelling Metrics by GU AE Outcome at 12 Weeks", style = "heading 2") |>
  body_add_par("Dest 1 cohort (CentreC + CentreA, n = 40). Boxes show IQR and median.",
               style = "Normal") |>
  body_add_img(tmp_swelling_outcome, width = 3.6, height = 3.6) |>
  body_add_par("Dest 1 Cohort: Swelling Metrics by Centre", style = "heading 2") |>
  body_add_par(sprintf("CentreC n = %d, CentreA n = %d. CentreB excluded: no per-fraction CTV volumes.", n_centreC_sw, n_centreA_sw),
               style = "Normal") |>
  body_add_img(tmp_d1_sw_centre, width = 6.5, height = 3.6) |>
  body_add_par("\u0394r Trajectories by ADT Status \u2014 Dest 1 Cohort", style = "heading 2") |>
  body_add_par("Light lines = individual patients (colour by centre). Black line = group mean.",
               style = "Normal") |>
  body_add_img(tmp_adt_traj, width = 6.5, height = 3.6) |>
  body_add_par("Swelling Metrics by ADT Status \u2014 Dest 1 Cohort", style = "heading 2") |>
  body_add_par(sprintf("ADT No n = %d, ADT Yes n = %d. CentreB excluded from swelling metrics.",
                        n_d1_adt_no, n_d1_adt_yes),
               style = "Normal") |>
  body_add_img(tmp_d1_sw_adt, width = 6.5, height = 3.6) |>
  body_add_par("Swelling Metrics by ADT Status \u2014 MOMENTUM SBRT Cohort", style = "heading 2") |>
  body_add_par(sprintf("n = %d/%d (%d%%) patients with ADT data. ADT No n = %d, ADT Yes n = %d.",
                        n_mom_adt_known, n_mom_total_pts, pct_mom_adt_known,
                        n_mom_adt_no, n_mom_adt_yes),
               style = "Normal") |>
  body_add_img(tmp_mom_sw_adt, width = 6.5, height = 3.6) |>
  body_add_par("Dest 1 vs MOMENTUM SBRT: Swelling Metrics by ADT", style = "heading 2") |>
  body_add_par("Descriptive comparison only. No inferential comparisons planned.",
               style = "Normal") |>
  body_add_img(tmp_compare_adt, width = 6.5, height = 5.1) |>
  body_add_par("Standard Logistic Regression: Swelling Metrics and GU AE",
               style = "heading 2") |>
   body_add_par(sprintf(paste0(
    "Primary models: standard logistic regression (glm, binomial family), exposure + baseline prostate volume ",
    "(centred on sample median: 52.8 cm\u00b3); n = 40 (CentreC + CentreA); EPV = %s. ",
    "Odds ratios with 95%% Wald confidence intervals and Wald p-values. ",
    "Model A (burden \u22653 mm) not fitted: zero-variance predictor (all patients = 0)."
  ), epv_val), style = "Normal") |>
  body_add_flextable(ft_primary) |>
  body_add_par(paste0(
    "Sensitivity models: ADT (Yes vs No) and baseline IPSS (centred on median: 7) ",
    "added separately to each primary model. EPV = 6.3 for 3-parameter sensitivity models."
  ), style = "Normal") |>
  body_add_flextable(ft_sens) |>
  body_add_par("SAP Pre-specified Deviations", style = "heading 2") |>
  body_add_par(deviation_text, style = "Normal") |>

  # 3) Figures section
  body_add_par("Figures", style = "heading 1")

for (i in seq_along(fig_list)) {
  w_in <- min(fig_list[[i]]$w, 6.5)
  h_in <- fig_list[[i]]$h * (w_in / fig_list[[i]]$w)
  doc <- doc |>
    body_add_par(fig_list[[i]]$title, style = "heading 2") |>
    body_add_img(tmp_figs[[i]], width = w_in, height = h_in)
}

temp_combined_path <- file.path(output_dir, "temp_tables_and_figures.docx")
print(doc, target = temp_combined_path)
file.copy(temp_combined_path, combined_path, overwrite = TRUE)

consort_final_path <- file.path(output_dir, "CONSORT_flow_diagram.png")
file.copy(consort_png, consort_final_path, overwrite = TRUE)

cat("\u2713 Combined tables + figures document saved to:", combined_path, "\n")
cat("\u2713 CONSORT flow diagram PNG saved to:", consort_final_path, "\n")
```
